title: Urban Mood DESIRE Victorian Tufted Velvet Ottoman
description:
Urban Mood DESIRE Victorian Tufted Velvet Ottoman
The modern adaptation of victorian tufted designs, the Desire velvet ottoman is a handsome addition to living room seating ensembles and lounge rooms. Explore our Edna and Arabelle ottomans for more shapes and sizes, to complement your classic or mid-century inspired homes!
Self collection at Northstar@AMK when items arrive, or islandwide delivery at a fee.
source_text:
Urban Mood DESIRE Victorian Tufted Velvet Ottoman Urban Mood DESIRE Victorian Tufted Velvet Ottoman

Self collection at Northstar@AMK when items arrive, or islandwide delivery at a fee.
